title: Trinity College Dublin Global Excellence Postgraduate Scholarships
duration: First year of a full-time postgraduate taught programme only
description: Trinity College Dublin awards Global Excellence Postgraduate Scholarships to exceptional international students who have received an offer for a full-time postgraduate taught programme. Awards are one-time reductions to tuition fees worth between €2,000 and €5,000 depending on the applicant's region, applied to the tuition fee bill. Applicants must hold non-EU fee status, and applications are assessed on a rolling basis against the deadline for their region. Business, engineering, natural sciences, and computer science and statistics programmes are excluded from this particular award.

duration: Duration of the eligible tertiary programme of study
description: The Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships are offered by the New Zealand Government to eligible citizens of developing countries to study at a New Zealand or Pacific education institution. description: The University of Otago Global Scholarships provide NZD $15,000 towards tuition fees to new international Bachelor degree students who hold a passport from one of twelve nominated countries — Bangladesh, China, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Macau, Malaysia, Singapore, South Korea, Sri Lanka, Taiwan, Thailand or Vietnam. title: Vice-Chancellor's Scholarships for International Students
description: The Vice-Chancellor's Scholarships for International Students provide NZD $10,000 towards tuition fees to new international students entering full-time undergraduate study at the University of Otago. There is no separate scholarship application: applicants are automatically assessed during the admission process and agree in their eVision application for study to be considered for international scholarships. The award has a one-year tenure, is paid only as a credit towards tuition fees, cannot be deferred, and is forfeited if study does not commence by the enrolment date in the Offer of Place.
